alive.last_commit_message:
fix(static): ignore MIME parameters in the resource allowlist (#279)

The static analyzer compared a resource's raw mimeType against
allowed_mime_types, so any type with parameters was skipped. MCP Apps UI
resources are text/html;profile=mcp-app, and they were reported as
"skipped" on the static path while the remote path scanned them, since
Scanner._normalize_mime_type already strips parameters there.

Normalize both sides the same way in static mode, and use the normalized
type for the HTML text extraction too, so a parameterized text/html body
gets the same treatment as on the remote path. The reported
resource_mime_type stays as declared.

Refs #272
